apis.name: vlan_hal_addGroup
apis.brief: Creates a new VLAN group and assigns the default VLAN ID. This function adds a new VLAN group to the system using the provided bridge name (`groupName`) and sets its default VLAN ID (`default_vlanID`). If a group with the same name already exists and has the same `default_vlanID`, it is considered a success. Valid values are: brlan0, brlan1, brlan2, brlan3, brlan4, brlan5, brlan7, brlan10, brlan106, brlan403, brlan112, brlan113, brebhaul.
apis.return_doc: The status of the operation. RETURN_OK - The operation succeeded, or the group already existed with the expected VLAN ID. RETURN_ERR - An error occurred during group creation. @note Possible errors: - VLAN ID is outside the valid range (1-4094). - A group with the same name exists, but with a different VLAN ID. - System-level errors during bridge creation or VLAN configuration. @todo Refactor return codes to use a more specific and informative enum (see general TODO).
